verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no data-export feature, no bulk or account-level export, and no named open export formats. The nearest items are adjacent: fetching individual transcripts via the API, viewing raw execution data in call history, and self-hosting the open-source framework. None of these is a product capability to export all of your data in open formats and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
